about.biography:
Hello, I'm Threona!

I am a Technical Artist, Game Developer, and Software Engineer who loves standing at the intersection of logical engineering and digital art.

My passion lies in crafting games with groundbreaking experiences and compelling narratives, where every line of code and every frame serves to resonate with the player's emotions.
Beyond making games, I have a deep-seated love for building custom software and tools that streamline the game dev and graphics pipelines, turning the most ambitious ideas into smooth, playable realities.

When I close my laptop, you'll find me diving into virtual worlds as an avid gamer, losing myself in good music, hitting the open road for a road trip, or battling it out on the basketball court with friends.
